PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED:

2024-02-24 | 1295 m MD | Tipam | mud_loss | high | 8.8 hrs NPT
Cause: Losses seen while running casing through Tipam, static losses continuing on connections.
Remedy: Spotted 58 bbl high-fluid-loss pill across the loss zone and monitored pit levels.

2024-02-25 | 1381 m MD | Tipam | mud_loss | medium | 6.9 hrs NPT
Cause: Total losses encountered in Tipam, no returns to surface for 6.9 hrs.
Remedy: Pumped cement plug to seal loss zone, waited on cement, tested integrity before resuming.

2024-02-25 | 1434 m MD | Tipam | mud_loss | medium | 4.3 hrs NPT
Cause: Total losses encountered in Tipam, no returns to surface for 4.3 hrs.
Remedy: Pumped cement plug to seal loss zone, waited on cement, tested integrity before resuming.

2024-02-25 | 1602 m MD | Barail | cementing_issue | low | 1.2 hrs NPT
Cause: Poor cement bond / losses during primary cementing of casing shoe in Barail.
Remedy: Squeeze cemented shoe track, pressure tested to spec before drilling out.

2024-02-28 | 2690 m MD | Kopili | wellbore_instability | low | 1.0 hrs NPT
Cause: Hole instability / cavings on surface while drilling Kopili, tight hole on connections.
Remedy: Increased mud weight and viscosity, short-tripped to condition hole.

2024-02-28 | 2706 m MD | Kopili | kick | medium | 6.5 hrs NPT
Cause: Gas-cut mud and increasing pit volume observed drilling Kopili, well flowing.
Remedy: Hard shut-in, recorded SIDPP/SICP, weighted up mud and circulated bottoms up.

2024-02-29 | 2844 m MD | Sylhet | mud_loss | low | 3.1 hrs NPT

Remedy: Spotted 102 bbl high-fluid-loss pill across the loss zone and monitored pit levels.
